luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local t = json.decode(json.encode({a = 1, b = {"x", "y"}, c = true}))
check(t.a == 1 and t.b[2] == "y" and t.c == true, "json roundtrip")
check(json.decode("null") == json.null, "json null")
check(require("json") == json, "require json")

local v = vec3i(1, 2, 3).add(vec3i(1, 1, 1)).scale(2)
check(v.getX() == 4 and v.getY() == 6 and v.getZ() == 8, "vec3i math")
local f = vec3f(-1.5, 0, 0)
check(f.floorToVec3i().getX() == -2 and f.toVec3i().getX() == -1, "vec3f rounding")
check(math.abs(vec3f(3, 4, 0).size() - 5) < 1e-6, "vec3f size")

local t0 = console.getTime()
util.sleep(50)
check(console.getTime() - t0 >= 40, "util.sleep")
check(util.now() > 0, "util.now")

check(load("return 1 + 2")() == 3, "load")
local co = coroutine.create(function(x) local y = coroutine.yield(x + 1) return y * 2 end)
local _, a = coroutine.resume(co, 1)
local _, b = coroutine.resume(co, 5)
check(a == 2 and b == 10, "coroutine")
print("PASS core_libs")
